logout.title: Signed Out
logout.message: You have been signed out successfully.

settings_form.title: Sign-in (OIDC)
settings_form.description: Connection to your OpenID Connect provider, claim mapping and API access.

provider.label: Provider
provider.help: Which provider preset to use, such as Entra or a generic OIDC provider. Changing it needs a restart.

discovery_url.label: Discovery URL
discovery_url.help: Address of the provider's discovery document. If blank, it is derived from the tenant ID where the provider supports that.

tenant_id.label: Tenant ID
tenant_id.help: Directory (tenant) ID for providers such as Entra. Single-tenant only.

client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.help: ID of the client registered for this app at the provider.

client_secret.label: Client secret
client_secret.help: Secret of that client. It is hidden once saved.

api_audience.label: API audience
api_audience.help: Audience that bearer tokens for the API must have. Leave blank to turn off bearer authentication.

api_allowed_client_ids.label: Allowed API clients
api_allowed_client_ids.help: Client IDs besides this app's own that may call the API with a bearer token. Empty: only this app's client.

trust_tenant_claim.label: Trust tenant claim in tokens
trust_tenant_claim.help: Use the tenant named in the token. Only enable if users cannot influence that claim.

scope.label: Scopes
scope.help: Scopes requested at sign-in. Leave as is to use the provider preset.

uid_claim.label: User ID claim
uid_claim.help: Token claim that uniquely identifies the user.

username_claim.label: Username claim
username_claim.help: Token claim checked first for the name the app displays.

email_claim.label: Email claim
email_claim.help: Token claim holding the email address.

name_claim.label: Display name claim
name_claim.help: Token claim used for the displayed name when the username claim is missing or empty.

roles_claim_path.label: Roles claim path
roles_claim_path.help: Where the list of roles sits inside the token, written as a dotted path.

jwks_cache_ttl_seconds.label: Signing key cache lifetime (seconds)
jwks_cache_ttl_seconds.help: How long the provider's signing keys are reused before being fetched again. With 0 they are refetched on demand, at most every 30 seconds, and the last good set is kept if a fetch fails.

role_mapping.label: Role mapping
role_mapping.help: Maps role names from the provider to this app's app-wide roles. Tenant roles come from memberships.
